sourceEnglishObjective: Identify the job's roof system and main materials
sourceEnglishSpeaking: Tell a crew member which roof system and materials today's job uses.
candidateObjective: 現場の屋根構成と主な材料を日本語で確認する。
candidateFocus: この屋根は～です names the system; ～を使います names the material. 陸屋根 and 勾配屋根 distinguish flat and sloped roofs. ～ですか forms a polite question.
curriculumAdaptationNote: Pin the Spanish/English roof-system lesson exactly. Japanese roof-system, shingle, tile and deck terms need qualified technical and dictionary review. The archived Reader changes 'walks the roof' to 'looks around the roof'; keep the source action visible and obtain a roofing safety decision. This packet is review evidence only and creates no learner course, audio, score or progress identity.

cards.reviewNote: Source Spanish explicitly says asphalt shingle; archived シングル材 and English 'shingle' omit asphalt. Confirm the Japanese sense and source's broader English label.
Source Spanish specifies clay/concrete tile; archived 屋根瓦 and English 'tile' omit those materials. A roofing dictionary reviewer must choose the intended sense.
Source 'roof deck' has two Spanish alternatives (cubierta / forro de techo). Confirm whether 屋根下地 preserves the intended structural component.
Source 'roof system' may mean the assembled system; archived 屋根構成 means roof composition. Confirm technical equivalence.

cards.sourceEnglish: What material does this roof have?
cards.archivedJapanese: この屋根には何の材料を使いますか。
cards.archivedEnglish: What material does this roof have?
cards.reviewNote: Source asks what material this roof has; archived Japanese asks what material people use on this roof. Decide whether to preserve the source's possession question or teach the use question.

cards.sourceSpanish: Hoy vamos a instalar tejas asfálticas.
cards.sourceEnglish: Today we are installing asphalt shingles.
cards.candidateJapanese: 今日はアスファルトシングルを施工します。
cards.archivedJapanese: 今日はアスファルトシングルを施工します。
cards.archivedEnglish: Today we are installing asphalt shingles.

cards.sourceSpanish: Este techo es de lámina metálica.
cards.archivedJapanese: この屋根は金属屋根パネルです。
cards.reviewNote: Source identifies the roof as metal panel material; archived Japanese identifies the entire roof as a metal panel. Confirm roofing phrasing.

cards.sourceEnglish: Is the roof flat or sloped?
cards.candidateJapanese: この屋根は陸屋根ですか、勾配屋根ですか。
cards.archivedJapanese: この屋根は陸屋根ですか、勾配屋根ですか。
cards.archivedEnglish: Is the roof flat or sloped?

cards.sourceSpanish: Revisen la pendiente del techo antes de empezar.
cards.sourceEnglish: Check the roof pitch before we start.
cards.candidateJapanese: 始める前に屋根勾配を確認してください。
cards.archivedJapanese: 始める前に屋根勾配を確認してください。
cards.archivedEnglish: Check the roof pitch before we start.

reader.sourceSpanish: Hoy es el primer día en la obra nueva.
reader.sourceEnglish: Today is the first day at the new job site.
reader.candidateJapanese: 今日は新しい現場での初日です。
reader.archivedJapanese: 今日は新しい現場での初日です。
reader.archivedEnglish: Today is the first day at the new job site.

reader.sourceSpanish: El capataz camina por el techo con la cuadrilla.
reader.sourceEnglish: The foreman walks the roof with the crew.
reader.archivedJapanese: 職長は作業員と一緒に屋根を見て回ります。
reader.archivedEnglish: The foreman walks the roof with the crew.
reader.reviewNote: Source says the foreman walks the roof; archived Japanese says the foreman looks around the roof with workers. Confirm safety and action meaning before selecting.

reader.sourceSpanish: Este techo es inclinado, no es plano.
reader.sourceEnglish: This roof is sloped, not flat.
reader.candidateJapanese: この屋根は陸屋根ではなく、勾配屋根です。
reader.archivedJapanese: この屋根は陸屋根ではなく、勾配屋根です。
reader.archivedEnglish: This roof is sloped, not flat.

reader.sourceSpanish: Es un sistema de techo con tejas asfálticas.
reader.sourceEnglish: It is a roof system with asphalt shingles.
reader.archivedJapanese: 屋根構成にはアスファルトシングルを使います。
reader.archivedEnglish: It is a roof system with asphalt shingles.
reader.reviewNote: Source says it is a roof system with asphalt shingles; archived Japanese says asphalt shingles are used in the roof composition. Confirm equivalence.

reader.sourceSpanish: El capataz pregunta: ¿Qué material tiene este techo?
reader.sourceEnglish: The foreman asks: What material does this roof have?
reader.archivedJapanese: 職長は「この屋根には何の材料を使いますか」と聞きます。
reader.archivedEnglish: The foreman asks: What material does this roof have?
reader.reviewNote: Source asks what material the roof has; archived Japanese asks what material is used. Coordinate with card 11.

reader.sourceSpanish: Un obrero mira el techo y contesta que son tejas asfálticas.
reader.sourceEnglish: A worker looks at the roof and answers that they are asphalt shingles.
reader.candidateJapanese: 作業員は屋根を見て、アスファルトシングルだと答えます。
reader.archivedJapanese: 作業員は屋根を見て、アスファルトシングルだと答えます。
reader.archivedEnglish: A worker looks at the roof and answers that they are asphalt shingles.

reader.sourceSpanish: También hay un tragaluz en la parte de atrás.
reader.sourceEnglish: There is also a skylight at the back.
reader.candidateJapanese: 裏側には天窓もあります。
reader.archivedJapanese: 裏側には天窓もあります。
reader.archivedEnglish: There is also a skylight at the back.

reader.sourceEnglish: Check the roof pitch before we start.
reader.candidateJapanese: 始める前に屋根勾配を確認してください。
reader.archivedJapanese: 始める前に屋根勾配を確認してください。
